posts.title: Pico FIDO2 Flake
posts.description: A Nix Flake to build a pinned version Pico FIDO2 in a sandbox for the Waveshare RP2350-one 1 . The project also provides some convenient tooling to flash the boards. No code modification is applied to the upstream repository. They are referenced as non-flake repositories inside the flake , and pinned in flake.lock . The following listing contains all useful outputs: nix build .#firmware # hermetic
